Ovulation & Fertile Window Calculator

Estimate your ovulation day, fertile window and next period from your last period start and cycle length.

Estimate only — not for contraception and not a fertility diagnosis. Talk to a doctor for medical guidance.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the first day of your last period.
  2. Enter your average cycle length in days (21–35).
  3. Read your estimated ovulation day.
  4. Check the fertile window and predicted next period.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the dates estimated?

Ovulation is estimated at cycle length minus 14 days after your last period started. The fertile window covers the 5 days before ovulation through the day after, based on sperm and egg survival times.

Can I use this as contraception?

No. Cycle-based estimates are not reliable contraception and cannot diagnose fertility issues. Do not use this to prevent pregnancy.

How accurate are the dates?

They are calendar estimates from averages. Stress, illness and natural variation shift real ovulation by days — treat these as rough guidance only.
